gripOrHq.title: Faked Hit
gripOrHq.rulesText: Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point. Take 2 brain damage. This damage cannot be prevented. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

gripOrHq.title: Viral Pipeline
gripOrHq.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Blackmail
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, score 1 agenda point.

heapOrArchives.title: Airport Locker
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [5], [T]: Search your stack for a program, and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. You may use this ability during an encounter with a piece of ice. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Viral Pipeline
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Garbage In
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Garbage counter. Two or more Garbage counters allow you to trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from R&D, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp loses two Garbage counters after any run during which this ability is used. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Garbage In
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Garbage counter. Two or more Garbage counters allow you to trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from R&D, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp loses two Garbage counters after any run during which this ability is used. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Faked Hit
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point. Take 2 brain damage. This damage cannot be prevented. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Streetware Distributor
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Take [1] from Streetware Distributor, if it has any bits, at the start of each of your turns. A: Put [3] from the bank on Streetware Distributor.

heapOrArchives.title: Bolt-Hole
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [T]: Prevent 2 meat damage. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: HQ Mole
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [4], [T]: Access two additional cards from HQ. Use this ability only when accessing cards from HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Subliminal Corruption
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. Give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point for each advertisement you trash during the run. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Scaldan
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Scaldan counter. Each Scaldan counter forces the Corp to roll a die at the start of each of its turns. On a 5 or a 6, the Corp gains 1 Bad Publicity point. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Live News Feed
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. If run is successful, the Corp gives you two tags, and you give the Corp 1 Bad Publicity point for each black ice you encountered during the run, 1 for each Black Ops card the Corp rezzed during the run, and 1 for each Black Ops agenda you liberated during the run. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

heapOrArchives.title: Senatorial Field Trip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if the Corp rezzed a piece of Black Ice this turn. The Corp either derezzes that piece of ice or receives 2 Bad Publicity points. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

rig.title: Vienna 22
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Vienna counter. Each Vienna counter allows you to access an additional card from HQ whenever you access cards from HQ. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Chiba Bank Account
rig.rulesText: [1], [T]: Gain [4]. You may use this ability whenever you pay any cost or penalty. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

ice.title: Haunting Inquisition
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Chicago Branch
root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

ice.title: Bolter Cluster
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 4 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.

encounteredIce.title: Bolter Cluster
encounteredIce.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 4 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.
